question: Can source-relative novelty and independently observed decision value distinguish durable research advances from valid execution work with reproducible, challengeable contributor credit?
inclusions: Research hypotheses, simulations, evaluators, study designs and product feedback

selection_criteria: Pin local baseline and closest prior
source_policy.freshness_rule: Refresh mutable sources at each review cut.
source_policy.conflict_handling: Preserve competing results and scope differences for independent adjudication.

stop_conditions: Missing owner or rights decision for non-synthetic data
Unreproducible baseline or leaked evaluation cut
limitations: No live token or revenue contract
claim_ceiling: Candidate inquiry only; no empirical finding.
